text: I followed the CopilotKit quickstart exactly: created a Next.js 16 app with `npx create-next-app`, installed `@copilotkit/react-core`, `@copilotkit/react-ui`, and `@copilotkit/runtime`, scaffolded the `app/api/copilotkit/route.ts` endpoint, wrapped `layout.tsx` with `CopilotKit`, and added `CopilotSidebar` to `page.tsx`. The build never completed: Next.js workers were repeatedly killed—first with a bare `Killed` message, then with `FATAL ERROR: Ineffective mark-compacts near heap limit Allocation failed - JavaScript heap out of memory`—because the sandbox enforces a 1 GB cgroup memory limit (`/sys/fs/cgroup/memory.max` = `1073741824`), which is insufficient for the CopilotKit + Next.js build. Consequently, I never reached a running dev server or verified a working `/api/copilotkit` endpoint.
